svg.text: READ AS: status ok · two readings · slot 01 (left) = 0x0A = 10 % · slot 03 (case) = 0 → “can't read, lid shut”
The right bud is missing entirely: it was flat. A missing slot means asleep or empty, so Earshot drops its stale value.
These are real bytes from a realme Buds Air 7, kept as test vectors in Earshot's ProtocolTests.swift.
